_about: Sam's rulings on the re-mint series readings sheet (docs/visuals/2026-09-03-remint-series-readings.html), the fourteen readings the two measure-first dry runs raised (kb/authority_recode_out/2026-09-03, kb/zband_retire_out/2026-09-03). This file is the PLAN the two applies consume beside kb/csr_authority_codes_rulings_2026-09-03.json; nothing here is applied by itself.
_status: RULED - the applies follow under docs/coursecontrolnumber_remint.md, one cron window, recode first.

readings.disposition: Administration of Justice keeps CRIM; the chip reads C-ID AJ (live in #1447). LPPS waits for identity-level chips.

Media Production shares FTVE with Film and Media Studies as a fan-in pair; Film keeps its numbers, Media Production's 202 rows gap-fill after them in title order; the pair recorded in kb/discipline_aliases.json like Theater.

The agriculture families take the hyphen-stripped codes AGAB, AGAS, AGPS, AGEH, AGMA by two agreeing signals (TOP never alone); the 235 one-signal rows are a curator's worklist after the fold, each carrying the family the one signal proposes.
Agriculture's residual is AGRI, Agricultural Production's is AGPR; both disciplines carry the five family codes.
Viticulture and enology (TOP 0104; VWT, VEN, WINE, VIT) stay residual on the discipline's own code until C-ID names a family.
Ornamental Horticulture keeps HORT with the C-ID AG-EH chip; inside the umbrella AGEH takes the Agriculture rows that classify as horticulture.
Arabic takes ARAB as ruled (measured ARBC 30 / ARAB 28).
Korean FLKO, Tagalog FLTA, Hebrew FLHE, Persian FLPE, Punjabi FLPU, Hmong FLHM, Greek FLGR and Nahuatl FLNA keep their CSR codes, flagged; a language may not take another language's code.
Armenian enters kb/foreign_language_subj4.json with ARME as its code and ARMN folded into it; ARAM, HUPA, KHME, FL, HIER, LING, NAL, TURK and YUR keep their keys until the file names them.
The item-17 dismissal is reversed for the one pair (PH, Health): Health shows C-ID PH beside C-ID PHS. Every other item-17 pair stays dismissed.
When a corroborated bucket fills, credit continues into the next band digit: KINE M2001 follows KINE M1999. The band digit carries no transferability meaning; no existing id changes.
The retired Z identities are materialized into the minted catalog at the apply: each becomes a real M-ID record (title, discipline, members) with origin 'machine cluster'.

The three anchors without a seed discipline (M-ID HOSP 100, 102, 104) wait for a curator to give them an MQ discipline; the 122 duplicates become a merge worklist on the CCR tab after the fold, not merged by the apply.

The two applies are built from the dry runs' compute_plan (apply equals spec) and land in one cron window, recode first then the retirement, kb_curation re-keyed from the receipts, the post-apply chain run once at the end.
